description: Output-only broad calibration from weak-positive native-1.16.2 direct-static net.

validation.hypothesis: native-1.16.2 carried a weak-positive direct-static signal but had over-amplified CP scale. Calibrate only the output layer on the broad native-1.13 mix to restore broad scale without destroying the direct-static hidden representation.
validation.only_change: trainable scope and calibration data: output-only Huber calibration from native-1.16.2 on native-1.13 broad rows; architecture remains scalar 16x12 and no new scoring/self-play is done.
validation.promotion_gate: clean provenance and broad engine-static at least as close to native-1.13 as native-1.16.2 before any SPRT; run a distributed 300-game smoke versus native-1.13 only if static passes.
